headline: Amicus tells Supreme Court lungs of even children in Delhi are 'not pink'
dek: Live Law reports that an amicus told the Supreme Court that the lungs of even children in Delhi are not pink, in a hearing on NCR pollution.
body:
An amicus told the Supreme Court that the lungs of even children in Delhi are not pink, according to a Live Law report on proceedings concerning NCR pollution.

The report's headline attributes the remark to the amicus, who is not named in the text available to LungDaily. The source gives no further detail on the hearing. It does not say what evidence was cited, what the court directed, or what measures were discussed.

The statement is the amicus's own submission to the court, as reported by Live Law. This article does not independently verify it.

LungDaily will update this report if fuller details of the hearing become available.
key_quote: Lungs Of Even Children In Delhi Not Pink
